correctness.rationale: The zero-frequency intensity fixes the common positive radius by I(0)=9v_d²r^(2d); dividing by the known nonzero near-origin ball Fourier factor recovers difference autocorrelation moments. For centered projected coordinates u_i with sum0: M2=6p2, M4=9p2², M6=(33/2)p2³-18p3². Thus the complete 2nd and 6th tensors recover p2(t) and polynomial p3(t)^2 for every direction, and the full 4th tensor is determined by the 2nd. Integral-domain square-root uniqueness gives p3 up to global sign; monic cubic z³-p2 z/2-p3/3 uniquely factors into center linear forms including multiplicity. Exact rational noncollinear pair C, Cprime with Cprime=C R orthogonal verifies equal covariance/4th moment but distinct cubic up to sign, proving no ≤5 jet uniformly identifies every triple. Checks address overlap/coincidence and d>=2 via polynomial argument, not finite tests alone.
